question: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\), \(CD\perp AB\) at \(D\), and \(\angle A=35^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle BCD\) in degrees.
solution: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle B=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\). In right triangle \(BCD\), \(\angle BCD=90^\circ-\angle B=35^\circ\).
